titles.native: デュエル・マスターズ ビクトリーV3

description:
The 9th Duel Masters series.

In this series the story continues after Katsuta defeats the YA.RA.SI band and also gains back his popularity by defeating Leo and his sidekick Nai Minamimo. In this series Katsuta will use a new race of Outrage creatures against the opposing new race of Oracle deck users. Also in the creature world a new time era will start off.
